summary.tldr: Authorizes $8.9 billion in federal spending for the 2023-24 fiscal year.
what_it_does: Authorizes $8,911,403,788 from the Consolidated Revenue Fund for the public service of Canada.
Covers expenses of the federal public administration that were not otherwise provided for in the 2023-24 fiscal year.
summary.background: The President of the Treasury Board introduced the bill in the House of Commons on 21 March 2024. It received Royal Assent on 22 March 2024.
